devices_mfe.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a Page Object Model class for HP Smart web application's device management micro-frontend. Notable patterns include: (1) Separation of verification and action flows with clear section comments, (2) Extensive use of wait_for_object with configurable timeout and raise_e parameters for robust element handling, (3) Multi-screen popup navigation support for onboarding flows (What's New popup with 3 screens), (4) JavaScript executor usage for clicking non-displayed elements (close button), (5) Keyboard interaction for page refresh using Selenium Keys, (6) Alpha/dummy printer implementation for testing environments where actual devices cannot be added, (7) Consistent naming convention with verify_* for assertions and click_*/get_* for actions, (8) Support for both visible and invisible element verification (e.g., verify_home_loggedin checks signin button invisibility), (9) Getter methods for extracting text content from popup screens for validation purposes.
